APIImagesPricing

Convert images to SVG with AI

Vectorize any bitmap into crisp, editable paths — right in your browser.

Drop your image here

Convert a raster image into a crisp, scalable, editable vector graphic.

PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, GIF or BMP, up to 20 MB

Browse files
100,000+ users2M+ SVGs generated

See what the AI preserves — and what it throws away.

SVGRASTER

From raster to vector in seconds.

Step 1

Upload

Drop in a PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, GIF or BMP. This is your image going in.

Step 2

Vectorize

Your image is redrawn as clean shapes: outlines, colors, curves, then a tidy up.

Step 3

Export

Out comes the finished SVG. Recolor or erase parts if you like, then download it.

How it works

Every image goes through the same four moves on its way from pixels to clean shapes.

Built for logos, icons and illustrations.

One file for every size

Resize it for any layout without exporting a separate image for each size.

Colors and gradients

Flat fills stay flat, and shading can be traced as SVG gradients. Reduce colors merges the near-duplicate shades that JPG compression leaves.

Shapes you can edit

Edges are Bézier curves. Recolor or erase shapes in the editor before you download.

Printing or cutting? The editor has modes for Cricut, laser engraving and screen printing, and exports DXF, EPS and PDF.

Wire SVG.new into any AI workflow.

Give Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client the ability to turn images into clean SVGs.

Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
